title: Ratio and proportion quiz
description: Ten questions drawn at random from a bank of thirteen, covering ratio problems, direct proportion and inverse proportion.

questions.prompt: Share 228 dollars in the ratio $5 : 1 : 6$. What is the largest share?
questions.explanation: $228 \div 12 = 19$ per part, so the largest share is $6 \times 19 = 114$.

questions.prompt: Share 2 hours in the ratio $3 : 7 : 5$ (in minutes).
Jamil and Sue share money in the ratio $9 : 2$. Sue gets 42 dollars less than Jamil. How much does Jamil get?
The angles of a triangle are in the ratio $2 : 3 : 2$. What type of triangle is it?
questions.explanation: Two angles are equal (both 2 parts), so it is isosceles. (The angles are about $51.4^\circ$, $77.1^\circ$, $51.4^\circ$.)

questions.prompt: 80 pens are red, blue and black in the ratio $3 : 8 : 5$. What is the probability a random pen is blue?
questions.explanation: Blue is 8 of 16 parts: $\frac{8}{16} = \frac{1}{2}$ (40 of the 80 pens).

questions.prompt: 5 pens cost 3.40 dollars. How much do 8 pens cost?
I change 80 US dollars into 64 euros. How many euros would I get for 73 dollars?
questions.explanation: The rate is $64 \div 80 = 0.8$ euros per dollar: $73 \times 0.8 = 58.4$.

questions.prompt: $x$ and $y$ are directly proportional, and $y = 4.5$ when $x = 3$. Write $y$ in terms of $x$.
6 taps fill a tank in 20 minutes. How long would 4 taps take?
Food for 80 people lasts 60 days. After 15 days, 20 more people join. How many more days will the food last?
questions.explanation: After 15 days there is enough for 80 people for 45 days: $80 \times 45 = 3600$ person-days. Shared by 100 people: 36 days.

questions.prompt: If $y$ is inversely proportional to $x$, doubling $x$ halves $y$.
Rectangles all have an area of 24 cm². How are their lengths and widths related?
questions.explanation: $l \times w = 24$ is constant, so as the length grows the width shrinks — inverse proportion.
